name: Convex Finance
description: Convex simplifies your Curve-boosting experience to maximize your yields.

methodology.Fees: Includes all treasury revenue, all revenue to CVX lockers and stakers and all revenue to liquid derivatives (cvxCRV, cvxFXS)
methodology.Revenue: Sum of protocol revenue and holders' revenue
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of revenue going to Convex treasury (includes caller incentives on Frax pools, POL yield and Votemarket bribes)
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All CRV, CVX and FXS rewards redistributed to liquidity providers staking on Convex.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All revenue going to CVX lockers and stakers
